sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Removes special buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1500. Success value 100. Magic damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Dark Spirit's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases dark elemental attack for all allies by 40, enchants the attacks of all allies with a 25% Light Bane. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
-Target: yourself. Applies Flank for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction: Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).

[The Phantom Thieves of Hearts] Joker or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
